lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the pre-released H1 finding moved from +0.1 to 0.0 and p_up from 51 to 50.

'Size the move on what is new; let reaction history move p_up, not abs_move_pct': abs_move_pct raised from 2.0 to 2.3 toward the ~3% pre-released base rather than anchoring on the name's ~1.2% median results reaction.
